basis: [bain_capital_heritage] Another desk (decisions.md D2, R1): 'MAXM Systems was acquired by Boole & Babbage in January 1997' (the firm's own 2012 company page), so Bain Capital's position predates 1997, before any Bain Capital venture vehicle existed (Bain Capital Venture Fund, L.P. dates from 1999). A position of Bain Capital's generalist funds, which the firm's 2003-2013 listings carry as history.

[bain_capital_heritage] OneSource's S-1 (1999): 'In connection with the management buy-out from Lotus in 1993, each of William Blair Venture Partners III Limited Partnership and Information Partners Capital Fund, L.P. ... purchased' the same stake, and each held 44.0% before the IPO; Information Partners Capital's general partner, David Dominik, was a managing director at Bain Capital. A 1993 buy-out in which the Bain Capital fund and its co-investor took 88%: a control acquisition, not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3 control positions; decisions.md D4), made before any Bain Capital venture vehicle existed (D2, R1). The firm's 2006 listing files it under 'Expansion/Growth Buyout'.

M|C Communications (Pri-Med medical education conferences, Boston): 'Mooney and Partners Agree to Sell M/C Communications to Bain Capital' (Trade Show Executive, 2004; expected price about $400M, 12 times EBITDA, closing August 2004). The founders sold the company; the vehicle was M|C Acquisition Corp. (Delaware, incorporated 2004; its 2009 Form D is a business-combination filing at the company's own address with John Connolly on the board), and the firm's 2006-2013 listings file it under 'Expansion/Growth Buyout'. An outright purchase of the company is a control acquisition, not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3 control positions; decisions.md D4).

M|C Acquisition Corp. is the 2004 acquisition vehicle of M|C Communications (merges into 'm-c-communications'), which Bain Capital bought outright from its founders in 2004 (Trade Show Executive): a control acquisition (COLLECTION.md s1 T3; decisions.md D4). This replaces the membership recorded for the merge.
